synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 未来12-36个月Coding Agent竞争将分化为两条可观测路径：(1)有完整披露链的厂商(OpenAI/Anthropic/GitHub)若补足企业留存与云/Token单品归因，将确立'入口-算力-收入'闭环；(2)国产厂商(Qoder/TRAE/CodeBuddy)若维持仅自报内部指标的状态，将停留在'产品力+控制面'阶段而无法证明商业闭环。该分化窗口大致在2026年Q2前后，因为Codex GA后一年的续费周期与Ramp类外部案例的独立验证均落在该区间。
synthesis.strategic_summary: 六家公司均已有产品入口，但当前公开证据没有一家闭合入口、控制、使用、留存、变现和单品云/Token归因六环。Microsoft GitHub(entry=confirmed,control=partial,usage=partial)；Anthropic(entry=confirmed,control=confirmed,monetization=confirmed)；OpenAI(entry=confirmed,usage=confirmed)；Alibaba Qoder(entry=confirmed,monetization=confirmed)；ByteDance TRAE(entry=confirmed,control=partial,usage=partial)；Tencent CodeBuddy(entry=confirmed,usage=partial)。这些状态只说明已核验材料覆盖到哪里，不构成市场排名。
synthesis.why_now: 六家公司中已有四家(OpenAI、Anthropic、GitHub、Qoder)在2025年完成企业版GA或定价披露，Codex与Claude Code相继在2025年Q2-Q3发布独立计费与控制面，市场从'补全工具'进入'企业席位+按量计费+控制面'阶段。
winner_conditions: 同时具备企业付费席位+周月活+工程任务结果+Token/云单品归因四环证据(参H1)
可观测/治理控制面被企业IT实际配置并对外披露使用透明度(参H2)
外部企业客户案例经过独立RCT或跨团队复核,而非仅厂商自报(参H3反证边界)

evidence.source_quote: 就我个人观点而言：1-2月，Qwen是最领先的；3月中下旬，Kimi一度获得了领先地位，但大家都在等待DeepSeek; 4月下旬，DeepSeek V4无疑是最领先和最受人关注的；6月下旬开始，GLM-5.2以其强大的编程能力上位，在大约一个月以后，又被Kimi K3夺走了很大一部分风头。

evidence.source_quote: This knowledge transfer ends up being one of the core values and advantages of an agentic organization. Senior judgment, which normally comes through years of pairing, code review, and mentoring, becomes something a team can work alongside in real time. This changes how mentorship can happen for an organization’s junior developers. A single senior’s perspective, encoded into Codex, can guide multiple less-seasoned teams in parallel.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Endava把Coding Agent用于放大资深工程能力(production context)

evidence.source_quote: Repository-level fields (API only) Repository-level reports show daily pull request creation, review, merge, and suggestion activity for repositories in an organization or enterprise, including pull requests created by Copilot cloud agent and reviewed by Copilot code review. Each row represents one repository that had pull request activity on the requested day; repositories with no activity are omitted. These reports focus on pull request lifecycle activity and can contain data even when IDE usage metrics are absent.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: GitHub官方Agent/code review分项观测(control_point confirmed)

evidence.source_quote: Core Result When developers are allowed to use AI tools, they take 19% longer to complete issues—a significant slowdown that goes against developer beliefs and expert forecasts. This gap between perception and reality is striking: developers expected AI to speed them up by 24%, and even after experiencing the slowdown, they still believed AI had sped them up by 20%.

evidence.source_quote: I managed to get a subscription to kimi and have been running kimi-code for the last few hours, having imported my claude-code skills, settings etc into it.I pointed it at a JS and python codebase I have been working on and asked it to review and refactor, then I got it to add some features - and boy, I am not impressed.TBH it looks the part with the running commentary it makes, but it seems to make some dumb mistakes.Compared to claude-code it is slow, time consuming, hungry on the tokens and multiple times it told me it was done and the app could not even start.I explicitly, and without any ambiguity, have standing orders that there is no type of silent failure that is acceptable in the current foreseen lifetime of our universe, and it still embedded a bunch of them in what was a relatively small amount of code I got it to generate.I am just not seeing that it comes close to claude-code running Anthropic models, based on this one particular codebase I have tried it on so far.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Kimi-code与Claude Code在代码库审查/重构场景下表现存在差距

evidence.source_quote: Engagement trends How the organization's adoption cohort mix and pull request throughput (total pull requests merged per month) have changed over the last six months.

We conduct a randomized controlled trial (RCT) to understand how early-2025 AI tools affect the productivity of experienced open-source developers working on their own repositories. Surprisingly, we find that when developers use AI tools, they take 19% longer than without—AI makes them slower. We view this result as a snapshot of early-2025 AI capabilities in one relevant setting; as these systems continue to rapidly evolve, we plan on continuing to use this methodology to help estimate AI acceleration from AI R&D automation.
